instruction: Have Glitch plug the data shard into his deck and crack whatever is on it.

target.reason: The page has no verb for plugging an item into a deck or cracking what is on it. Glitch can be given the data shard (rogue offers it, glitch accepts), but that only reaches a holder end state and does not carry out the plugging or cracking the instruction asks for.
